excerpt: The PADME Experiment at the Frascati DAΦNE linear accelerator has searched for a hypothetical particle with mass around 17 MeV, commonly referred to as the X17, using a positron beam incident on a fixed target.
publisher: PADME Collaboration (F. Bossi et al.) / JHEP 11 (2025) 007 / arXiv
title: Search for a new 17 MeV resonance via e+e- annihilation with the PADME Experiment
